# Publication Claims Policy

## Safe claims

- DH-ADOM proposes a repository-level operating model for governed AI-native software engineering.
- DH-ADOM formalizes persistent Root, Feature, and Specialist roles with explicit bounded delegation.
- DH-ADOM integrates AI-SDLC and ADLC with feature ownership and evidence-oriented handoff.

## Claims to avoid without empirical evidence

- "DH-ADOM is the first hierarchical agent model."
- "DH-ADOM guarantees safe autonomous development."
- "DH-ADOM always improves coding performance."
- "DH-ADOM eliminates agent hallucination or security risk."

Empirical claims require a published benchmark protocol and reproducible results.
